guidelines.text: Friendly, plain and encouraging. Avoid hype and pressure.
Absolute or comparative performance claims (fastest, best, zero errors, 100%) require a verified entry in the approved fact sheet.
Never say a product cures, treats or guarantees an outcome. Use 'supports' or 'designed to help'.
Write the brand as Acme (first mention Acme Wellness). Never ACME or acme.
Published copy must not contain personal email addresses or phone numbers. Use the official contact page.
Every image needs alt text. Keep average sentence length under 25 words.

sample_content: ACME cures everything and is the fastest in the world. Contact sales@acme.io to guarantee results. Founded in 2015.
